title: Mono styling tokens and power budget enforcement
description: Implement the three-token styling system from spec 19 §7 and power budget rules from §6. Tokens: normal (E=black-on-white, O=lit), inverse (E=white-on-black, O=dark), dim (E=sparse dither, O=off pixels). Semantic roles: alert→inverse, header→inverse, quiet→dim. No fourth token. Power budget: E=partial refresh per state change only, full refresh at boot + every N partials. O=redraw on change, screensaver after 60s unchanged. H=LED changes are events not heartbeats. No periodic refresh ever. Spans spec 19 requirements 35-43.
